description: This file defines the interface ShuffleMapOutputWriter, which manages writing and committing shuffle map output data in Apache Spark. It includes methods for creating partition writers, committing all partition writes, and aborting operations.

classes.name: ShuffleMapOutputWriter
classes.description: Interface for writing shuffle map output, supporting creation of partition writers, commit, and abort operations.

methods.name: getPartitionWriter
methods.description: Creates a writer for persisting bytes for a specific reduce partition.

methods.name: commitAllPartitions
methods.description: Commits all partition writes and returns a message with byte counts and optional metadata.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts all ongoing writes and cleans up resources.
